meta.name: linkedin-repurposer
meta.description: Repurpose existing content into a native LinkedIn post. Take a tweet, thread, YouTube video, blog, or newsletter and rebuild it for LinkedIn: re-hook before the fold, expand to the 900 to 1300 char sweet spot, add whitespace and a CTA, move links to the first comment, run the humanizer, publish via Publora on approval. Not for writing from scratch (use linkedin-post-writer), not for auditing a draft (use linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把推文、视频或博客改写成原生 LinkedIn 帖子,排版好并一键发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上已有推文、视频或博客,想快速改成 LinkedIn 帖子发出去
copy.tagline_en: Turn tweets, videos, or blogs into native LinkedIn posts, formatted and ready to publish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have tweets, videos, or blogs to reshape into ready-to-post LinkedIn updates

howto.what: 把你已有的推文、视频、博客或 newsletter 重做成 LinkedIn 原生帖:重写前 210 字符内的钩子、扩到 900~1300 字符、加留白与 CTA、把链接移到首条评论,确认后经 Publora 发布。
howto.when: 当你要求把推文、视频、博客或 newsletter 改成 LinkedIn 帖子时接管。不负责从零写稿或审阅已有草稿。

howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a tweet, video, blog or newsletter into a LinkedIn post. Not for writing from scratch (linkedin-post-writer) or auditing a draft (linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).
